analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY in confirmed uptrend (+1.0% vs SMA50, slope +1.12%). Constructive backdrop but not a reason to force trades.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW — CRITICAL:
1. AMP (-11.33%, $9,218): This is the most urgent concern. We have been stopped out of AMP twice before (-3.12%, -3.81%) and re-entered each time only to take another loss. The position is now down 11.33% from avg cost of $547.12 — approaching the 15% hard stop ceiling. Repeated losses in the same ticker signal a thesis that the market is consistently rejecting. AMP is NOT in today's screened candidate list, which itself is a signal. Recommend treating $465 (~15% below avg cost) as a hard stop and NOT re-entering AMP after exit. Thesis-break condition: three consecutive stop-outs in the same name is the definition of broken.
2. BR (-3.52%): Manageable, thesis intact. Broadridge is quality; hold unless stop hit.
3. FOXA (+0.35%): Essentially flat, no urgency either way. Hold.
4. MCO (-0.81%): Near breakeven, Moody's thesis intact (durable moat, credit cycle tailwind). Hold.
5. NVDA (+3.55%): Only outright winner; thesis remains strong (AI infrastructure, exceptional FCF, EPS revision +22.6%). Confirmed in screened list at 85% range — do not add here as it is extended.

OVERALL PERFORMANCE CONTEXT: 9.1% win rate, profit factor 0.03x, Sortino -15.25. This is a deeply negative record. The primary obligation right now is STOPPING THE BLEEDING — not generating new exposure. The backtest finding embedded in the mandate (no demonstrated stock-picking edge over SPY) should be respected.

CAPACITY: We are at 5 positions — the UPPER BOUND of the 3-5 target. Adding a 6th position violates the concentration discipline. Until AMP is resolved (stopped or thesis dramatically reverses), there is no room for a new name. Headroom ($28,827) is a necessary cushion, not an invitation to deploy.

WATCH LIST FOR NEXT CYCLE: IT (Gartner) is the highest-quality setup if a slot opens — basing at 39% of 52w range, forward P/E ~11, FCF yield ~10%, PEG 0.71, EPS revisions +6.9%, earnings 39 days out. Would size ~$15-16k with stop at 1.75x ATR (~$164, -8.5%). Keep on radar.

DECISION: Zero new trades. Portfolio is at position cap, record demands restraint, and AMP requires attention before any capital is committed. Cash is the correct position today.
